idea-plugin.name: CaseHub Pages
idea-plugin.description:
Language intelligence for CaseHub Page YAML — completion, diagnostics, hover, rename, find references — powered by the pages-lsp server.

Supported formats

  • *.page.yaml — Page definitions

For all five CaseHub YAML formats (Page, CaseDefinition, SWF, HTN, Org), install CaseHub YAML instead — it supersedes this plugin.

Requirements

  • Node.js 18+ on PATH
  • LSP4IJ plugin
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial release — LSP client via LSP4IJ
  • Schema-driven completion, diagnostics, hover for Page YAML format
  • Rename, find references, go to definition
  • jq expression intelligence
